value.rationale: Axiom-to-frame correspondence is a central issue in intuitionistic modal semantics. SNDR strictly enlarges the published sufficient frame class, with the first sharp separating size three; the exact all-n chain count quantifies how many concrete frames were omitted and yields a testable complete classification. It is not an arbitrary parameter slice or isolated small numerical gain.
